description: This file defines a REST controller for managing Question entities, providing endpoints for CRUD operations such as retrieving questions, creating a new question, updating existing questions, and deleting questions within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller for Questions, handling HTTP requests for CRUD operations.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question by ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a question by ID.
